targets.characterization: Primarily skill/agent/rule Markdown. One executable JS surface: skills/pr-review-canvas/renderer.js (+ template.html/styles.css companion assets).

limitations_notable: template.html inline JavaScript body starting at line 10 was not analyzed

entrypoints.role: CLI launcher; calls bootstrap then cli
ensures commander via bun install --frozen-lockfile; Bun.spawnSync

child_process_and_config: bootstrap.ts uses Bun.spawnSync([bun, install, --frozen-lockfile]) then re-execs self
watch-pr/github.ts spawns external CLI (gh) via node:child_process.spawn for PR/check/comment reads
check-plan.test.ts / github.test.ts spawn node/bun for tests
Runtime npm dep: commander@14.0.0 (locked). Dev: bun-types@1.3.14, typescript@7.0.2

entrypoints.role: TLC/Java orchestration via execFile/spawn; mise java@temurin-25

child_process_and_config: run.ts resolves TLC via mise (tlc tool) or TLA2TOOLS/JAVA env; JAVA_TOOL=java@temurin-25
run.ts execFile/spawn java -jar tla2tools for tlc2.TLC; kill process groups via /bin/sh
statechart.ts spawns worker and janitor child processes
npm: fast-check@4.5.3 as devDependency only (no lockfile in tree)

pstack_plugin_root.note: Installed cache has marker file .cache-complete; all shared content hashes match tip.

files.notes: Only JS under cursor-team-kit. template.html inline script not analyzed by REA (explicit limitation).
